37289-susan-clegg-and-her-love-affairs.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. If the reader knows Susan Clegg at all, he will surmise that she was talking. Susan was most emphatically talking. She had returned from the Sewing Society full to the brim, and Mrs. Lathrop was already enjoying the overflow. Lathrop liked to rock and listen. She never went to the Sewing Society herself--she never went anywhere.

arxiv-1904-05086.title: A Framework for Multi-f 0 Modeling in SATB Choir Recordings
arxiv-1904-05086.description: Abstract Fundamental frequency (f 0 ) modeling is an important but relatively unexplored aspect of choir singing. Performance evaluation as well as auditory analysis of singing, whether individually or in a choir, often depend on extracting f 0 f_{0} contours for the singing voice.

arxiv-2011-10608.title: Large Scale Neural Architecture Search with Polyharmonic Splines
arxiv-2011-10608.creator: Ulrich Finkler, Michele Merler, Rameswar Panda, Mayoore S. Jaiswal, Hui Wu, Kandan Ramakrishnan, Chun-Fu Chen, Minsik Cho, David Kung, Rogerio Feris, Bishwaranjan Bhattacharjee
arxiv-2011-10608.description: Abstract Neural Architecture Search (NAS) is a powerful tool to automatically design deep neural networks for many tasks, including image classification. Due to the significant computational burden of the search phase, most NAS methods have focused so far on small, balanced datasets.

arxiv-2106-12931.title: Spatial-Temporal Graph ODE Networks for Traffic Flow Forecasting Conference: Proceedings of the 27th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 14–18, 2021; Virtual Event, Singapore Proceedings of the 27th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD ’2
arxiv-2106-12931.creator: Zheng Fang, Qingqing Long, Guojie Song, Kunqing Xie
arxiv-2106-12931.description: Abstract . Spatial-temporal forecasting has attracted tremendous attention in a wide range of applications, and traffic flow prediction is a canonical and typical example. The complex and long-range spatial-temporal correlations of traffic flow bring it to a most intractable challenge. Existing works typically utilize shallow graph convolution networks (GNNs) and temporal extracting modules to model spatial and temporal dependencies respectively.

arxiv-2206-03831.title: Identification testing via sample splitting – an application to Structural VAR models Journal: Renewable Energy
arxiv-2206-03831.creator: Katarzyna Maciejowska
arxiv-2206-03831.description: Abstract In this article, a novel identification test is proposed, which can be applied to parameteric models such as Mixture of Normal (MN) distributions, Markow Switching(MS), or Structural Autoregressive (SVAR) models. In the approach, it is assumed that model parameters are identified under the null whereas under the alternative they are not identified.

arxiv-2305-07086.title: IceCube: Neutrinos from Active Galaxies
arxiv-2305-07086.creator: F. Halzen
arxiv-2305-07086.description: Abstract The IceCube project transformed a cubic kilometer of transparent, natural Antarctic ice into a Cherenkov detector. It discovered neutrinos of TeV-PeV energy originating beyond our Galaxy with an energy flux that exceeds the one of high-energy gamma rays of extragalactic origin. Unlike at any other wavelength of light, extragalactic neutrinos outshine the nearby sources in our own Milky way.

arxiv-2309-11870.title: Automated Probe Life-Cycle Management for Monitoring-as-a-Service
arxiv-2309-11870.creator: Alessandro Tundo, Marco Mobilio, Oliviero Riganelli, and Leonardo Mariani
arxiv-2309-11870.description: Abstract Cloud services must be continuously monitored to guarantee that misbehaviors can be timely revealed, compensated, and fixed. While simple applications can be easily monitored and controlled, monitoring non-trivial cloud systems with dynamic behavior requires the operators to be able to rapidly adapt the set of collected indicators.

arxiv-2402-16426.title: Band-limited wavelets beyond Gevrey regularity
arxiv-2402-16426.creator: Nenad Teofanov ∗, Filip Tomić, Stefan Tutić
arxiv-2402-16426.description: Abstract . It is known that a smooth function of exponential decay at infinity can not be an orthonormal wavelet. Dziubański and Hernández constructed smooth orthonormal wavelets of Gevrey type subexponential decay. We weaken the Gevrey type decay and construct orthonormal wavelets of subexponential decay related to the so-called extended Gevrey classes.

arxiv-2409-16245.title: Material Transport in Protoplanetary Discs with Massive Embedded Planets 2024 Material Transport in Protoplanetary Discs with Massive Embedded Planets – 12
arxiv-2409-16245.creator: Hannah J. Petrovic, Richard A. Booth, Cathie J. Clarke
arxiv-2409-16245.description: Abstract Vertical gas and dust flows in protoplanetary discs waft material above the midplane region in the presence of a protoplanet. This motion may alter the delivery of dust to the planet and its circumplanetary disc, as well as through a planetary-induced gap region and hence the inner disc chemistry.

arxiv-2503-16509.title: Earthquake Response Analysis with AI
arxiv-2503-16509.creator: Deep Patel, Panthadeep Bhattacharjee, Amit Reza, Priodyuti Pradhan
arxiv-2503-16509.description: Abstract A timely and effective response is crucial to minimize damage and save lives during natural disasters like earthquakes. Microblogging platforms, particularly Twitter, have emerged as valuable real-time information sources for such events. This work explores the potential of leveraging Twitter data for earthquake response analysis.

arxiv-2602-15560.title: Bridging Scales in Black Hole Accretion and Feedback: Subgrid Prescription from First Principles
arxiv-2602-15560.creator: Hyerin Cho (조혜린), Ben S. Prather, Ramesh Narayan, Kung-Yi Su, Angelo Ricarte, Priyamvada Natarajan, Antonio J. Porras-Valverde

pmc-10589782.title: CD19 CAR T-cell therapy demonstrates activity against extramedullary disease in pediatric patients with B-ALL
pmc-10589782.creator: Rebecca Epperly, Barry L. Shulkin, Asim K. Bag, Cheng Cheng, Hiroto Inaba, John T. Lucas, Swati Naik, Brandon M. Triplett, Stephen Gottschalk, Aimee C. Talleur
pmc-10589782.description: Visual Abstract TO THE EDITOR: CD19 chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy generates impressive responses in pediatric patients with relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (r/r B-ALL).1, 2, 3, 4 Although the focus of initial studies was bone marrow disease, signals of activity toward extramedullary disease (EMD) are emerging.

pmc-12785441.title: Integrated Assessment of the Cardiotoxic and Neurobehavioral Effects of 3,4-Methylenedioxypyrovalerone (MDPV) in Zebrafish Embryos
pmc-12785441.creator: Ouwais Aljabasini, Niki Tagkalidou, Juliette Bedrossiantz, Eva Prats, Raul Lopez-Arnau, Demetrio Raldua
pmc-12785441.description: Synthetic cathinones such as 3,4-methylenedioxypyrovalerone (MDPV) are potent psychostimulants with high abuse potential, yet their systemic toxicity and neurobehavioral effects remain poorly characterized during early development. Using Danio rerio (zebrafish) embryos and larvae, we performed an integrated assessment of the cardiotoxic, behavioral, and molecular effects of MDPV.

pmc-13194372.title: Serum metabolomic profiling reveals LysoPC/PC depletion as a potential biomarker to detect avian reoviral infection in neonatal broiler chickens
pmc-13194372.creator: Asha Ranaraja, Iresha Subhasinghe, Noor Ahmad Shaik, Babajan Banaganapalli, Shelly Popowich, Lisanework E. Ayalew, Rupasri Mandal, David S. Wishart, Suresh Tikoo, Susantha Gomis
pmc-13194372.description: IntroductionAvian reovirus (ARV) infection causes viral arthritis in broiler chickens, leading to lameness and substantial economic loss in poultry production. Current conventional diagnostic methods detect infection only after clinical signs appear, limiting the ability to prevent disease progression. Hence, this study utilized serum metabolomics to identify early biomarkers of ARV infection prior to tissue damage.

pmc-13395782.title: Multimodal biomarkers in idiopathic sudden sensorineural hearing loss: integrating immune, vascular, and metabolic perspectives for precision medicine
pmc-13395782.creator: Qian Li, Hang Li, Haiyuan Zhao
pmc-13395782.description: Idiopathic Sudden Sensorineural Hearing Loss (ISSNHL) is a common otological emergency driven by intertwined microcirculatory disorders, immune-inflammatory activation and metabolic dysregulation.This narrative overview collates representative published evidence to summarize research advances on hematological, immunological and metabolomic biomarkers, with a focus on their investigational—not yet clinically validated— diagnostic and prognostic potential.

pmc-13444132.title: Grey–green spatial morphology relates to summer daytime and nighttime land surface temperature across local climate zones in Wuhan
pmc-13444132.creator: Ziyi Jiang, Jing Bai, Yuanyuan Zhang, Yifei Wang
pmc-13444132.description: Urban grey and green spaces jointly shape the urban thermal environment, yet their associations with land surface temperature (LST) are spatially heterogeneous and context-dependent. Existing studies have mainly focused on the city-wide scale or on individual spatial elements, with limited attention to the differentiated mechanisms through which grey–green space affects LST across Local Climate Zone (LCZ).

pmc-13505648.title: Addressing Reproducibility of MXene Synthesis Using Electrochemical and Chemical Treatment of Ti3AlC2 With Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide
pmc-13505648.creator: Bartosz Gurzęda, Nicolas Boulanger, Mads Ry Vogel Jørgensen, Innokenty Kantor, Christoph Hennig, Alexandr V Talyzin
pmc-13505648.description: Electrochemical etching of Ti3AlC2 in an aqueous electrolyte consisting of 1 M NH4Cl and 0.2 M tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAOH) is widely cited as a method to produce fluorine‐free MXene. However, an alternative method for producing MXene by purely chemical etching of Ti3AlC2 with an aqueous TMAOH has also been reported.

pmc-13587480.title: Fatigue and pain in children with multiple osteochondromas: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13587480.creator: Ihsane Amajjar, Nienke W. Willigenburg, Rob J.E.M. Smeets, S. John Ham
pmc-13587480.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMultiple osteochondromas (MO) is a rare, inherited disorder characterized by multiple benign bone tumors. Although pain and fatigue are commonly encountered in clinical practice, their impact on children with MO remains largely unaddressed in literature.

pmc-13673226.title: Impact of depth-of-interaction and spatially-variant point-spread-function model on the performance of ultra-high resolution brain PET
pmc-13673226.creator: Tianyi Zeng, Yassir Najmaoui, Jiazhen Zhang, Tommaso Volpi, Kathryn Fontaine, Yanis Chemli, Yifan Hu, Jean-Dominique Gallezot, Chen Sun, Yihuan Lu, Georges El Fakhri, Richard E Carson, Thibault Marin
pmc-13673226.description: Objective. To implement a spatially-variant point spread function (VarPSF) model for the NeuroEXPLORER (NX) brain positron emission tomography (PET) scanner in the open-source Yale Reconstruction Toolkit for PET, and investigate the interplay between depth-of-interaction (DOI) resolution and resolution modeling. Approach. PSF parameters were estimated from simulated and physically measured point sources.

pmc-13682833.title: Itaconate as the endogenous brake of proinflammatory macrophage activation alleviates inflammation in liver fibrogenesis
pmc-13682833.creator: Kai Zhang, Tong Li, Wenhui Liu, Weiyang Li, Lin Yang, Na Chang, Liying Li
pmc-13682833.description: Background:Liver inflammation and fibrosis are reparative responses to chronic liver injury. Bone marrow–derived monocyte/macrophages (BMDMs) are key participants. Our previous study demonstrated that BMDM can be activated as a proinflammatory phenotype by sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P). Aconitate decarboxylase 1 (ACOD1)/itaconate is an anti-inflammatory molecule. However, it remains unclear whether ACOD1/itaconate is involved in S1P-induced BMDM activation.
